value.rationale: The triangular hat is the first continuous compact B-spline and its ambiguity zeros encode time-frequency orthogonality. At T=2/3 exactly coincident 1:2 inner/outer knot spacings and jump amplitudes yield an exact, not arbitrarily chosen, resonance: complete positive-Doppler census, infinitely many double integer zeros, explicitly asymptotic simple integer zeros, and transverse two-variable nodal crossings. Such global multiplicity and nodal geometry is mathematically substantive compared with an isolated Fourier evaluation.
